import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf

    d = df.dropna(subset=['yield_kg',e]).copy()
    d['sq']=d[e]**2

    print(f"{e:18s} lin p={m.pvalues[e]:.3f} sq p={m.pvalues['sq']:.3f}")
print()
# missingness
print(df.isna().sum())
# correlations with yield
print(df[exps+['yield_kg']].corr()['yield_kg'])

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
exps = ['nitrogen_ppm','phosphorus_ppm','potassium_ppm','soil_ph','irrigation_mm','seed_density','mulch_depth_cm','biochar_g','fungicide_ml','shade_pct']
print(df[exps].corr().round(2))
print()
# full model
d = df.dropna(subset=['yield_kg']+exps)
m = smf.ols('yield_kg ~ '+' + '.join(exps)+' + C(farm)', data=d).fit()
print(m.summary())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
d = df.dropna(subset=['yield_kg','potassium_ppm'])
# by farm
for f,g in d.groupby('farm'):
    m = smf.ols('yield_kg ~ potassium_ppm', data=g).fit()
    print(f, len(g), 'coef=%.4f p=%.3f'%(m.params['potassium_ppm'], m.pvalues['potassium_ppm']))
print()
# robust
m = smf.ols('yield_kg ~ potassium_ppm + C(farm)', data=d).fit(cov_type='HC3')
print('HC3 p=', m.pvalues['potassium_ppm'])
# without farm
m2 = smf.ols('yield_kg ~ potassium_ppm', data=d).fit()
print('no farm coef=%.4f p=%.4f'%(m2.params['potassium_ppm'], m2.pvalues['potassium_ppm']))
# distribution
print(d['potassium_ppm'].describe())
